title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation (php) — review required
description: In php, mysqli_querys*((?:[^()]|([^()]*))*(?:"[^"n]*$|.s*$) mixes code and data in one SQL string. Concatenation is the classic injection primitive: quotes and keywords in the input rewrite the statement. The remedy is bound parameters via prepared statements with bind_param.
applicability: php codebases issuing SQL through the flagged call; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise (read, write, execute) when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
